I own both dark blues now that I've got Park Place and Boardwalk, so unmortagging them to build would give me another monopoly to pressure GPT with. The real constraint is the bank only has 8 houses left, and my pinks are already maxed at 4 houses each, so I need to think through whether continuing this scarcity strategy or pivoting to develop the dark blues makes more sense. es up my pink monopoly income stream. My opponents are pretty weak financially—Gemini's barely hanging on and GPT just paid me for the railroads.
